action_summary: Removed all six active fold-checkpoint deletion commands so the BiEncoderEvaluator can ensemble every supplied fold model. This restores the ensemble composition documented for v16, whose recorded score of 0.38513 exceeded v17 by 0.01086. Kept the existing Kaggle paths, checkpoint, sigmoid blending, batch size, evaluator interface, notebook cell structure, and submission writer. Added a comment explaining why the checkpoints must be retained. No training or inference was run; the expected improvement is supported by the prior score rather than a new evaluation.
